description: This Java source file defines a class JsonPathExceptionMapper that implements ExceptionMapper for handling JsonPathException in a RESTful web service. It maps such exceptions to HTTP 400 responses with a standardized error message.

classes.name: JsonPathExceptionMapper
classes.description: A class that handles mapping JsonPathException to HTTP responses in a REST API context. Implements ExceptionMapper and FineractExceptionMapper, annotated as a singleton provider.

methods.name: toResponse
methods.description: Converts a JsonPathException into a Response object with status BAD_REQUEST, including a standard error message.

methods.name: errorCode
methods.description: Returns an integer error code associated with this exception mapping, here 4000.
